answer: Require every trading agent to post a copper bond: a small deposit of a scarce token held in escrow for the epoch. The bond size is set to the delta between an honest agent's expected profit and a fake identity's gain, so spawning extra identities costs more than any of them can earn. Agents must also complete a timber-style proof of sequential work, a slow computation that cannot be parallelized across identities. A sybil attacker therefore pays one copper bond and one slow proof per fake identity, while an honest agent pays only once. Misbehavior forfeits the bond.
